Homrich & Berg Holds Position in Apple (AAPL); Snap On (SNA) Shareholder Nomura Asset Management Company LTD Has Cut Holding
June 27, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Homrich & Berg increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 9.7% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Homrich & Berg bought 7,806 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 88,282 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $14.81 million, up from 80,476 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Homrich & Berg who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $905.17 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.15% or $0.27 during the last trading session, reaching $184.16. About 22.45 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
